_note: Fill in `inputs` using the unit in each _guide entry. Help text may quote SI units; the `unit` field is the one that applies. psig and psia are different: gauge arguments (set_g, back_g ...) are psig, absolute ones psia. Temperatures are readings, not differences.

matrix.help: print the derogation approval matrix (TA1/TA2/TA3 by tier and consequence class) as Markdown

as_of.help: date for expiry checks, YYYY-MM-DD (default: the register's as_of, else today)

init.help: start a register (every clause open) from a CSV written by the requirements command

out.help: with --init: register JSON to write; must be outside version control or git-ignored

allow_tracked.help: write even if --out is inside a git repository and not ignored
